Re:       PJM Interconnection, L.L.C., Docket No. EL25-49-000, et al.
          Compliance Filing in Docket No. ER26-1479-002

Dear Secretary Reese:

          This letter, being served on all parties to the above-referenced proceeding, confirms

that PJM Interconnection, L.L.C. (“PJM”) submitted on August 17, 2026, a filing in Docket

No. ER26-1479-002 (Accession No. 20260817-5195) in compliance with the Federal

Energy Regulatory Commission’s sixty-day compliance directives in the June 18, 2026

order1 and the notice granting an extension of time for certain compliance obligations.2

PJM requested an effective date of October 17, 2026, for the revisions in Parts I, III, VI,

VII, VIII, and IX and June 1, 2028, for the provisions in Part XI. On August 18, 2026, the

Commission set 5 PM ET on September 8, 2026, for comments on this filing.3




1
    PJM Interconnection, L.L.C., 195 FERC ¶ 61,209 (2026).

2026).
